name: UCSF ChimeraX
summary: Interactive molecular and cryo-EM density visualization and analysis.

steps: Read the official ChimeraX non-commercial or commercial license, and have the user accept the applicable terms before downloading.
Select the official installer for the host operating system and graphics hardware; review the current system requirements and installer provenance.
Install to a user-approved location and confirm GUI startup. Do not treat a headless CLI check as proof that graphics and map rendering work.
install.verify_note: Launch ChimeraX and inspect its version and basic rendering with a user-approved example; do not fetch structures automatically.

notes: ChimeraX is free of charge for permitted non-commercial use, while commercial use needs a separate written license.
